overview.description: The ProShares UltraShort Technology (REW) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Technology Select Sector index. The fund provides 2x leveraged inverse exposure to a market-cap-weighted index that measures the performance of large US technology companies. REW was launched on Jan 30, 2007 and is issued by ProShares.
